sections.heading: Fluid Propertiesoperator
sections.content: The Fluid Properties operator allows you to save various fluid grid properties to particle custom data channels.

sections.heading: Fluid Node
sections.content: Fluid input object: the fluid grid object that properties will be loaded from.

sections.heading: Velocity (vector)
sections.content:
Enabled: controls whether grid velocity values will be saved to a particle’s custom vector data channel.Channel: the custom vector data channel in which to store the data.

Enabled: controls whether grid velocity values will be saved to a particle’s custom vector data channel.

Channel: the custom vector data channel in which to store the data.

sections.heading: Smoke (float)
sections.content:
Enabled: controls whether grid smoke values will be saved to a particle’s custom float data channel.Channel: the custom float data channel in which to store the data.

Enabled: controls whether grid smoke values will be saved to a particle’s custom float data channel.

Channel: the custom float data channel in which to store the data.

sections.heading: Temperature (float)
sections.content:
Enabled: controls whether grid temperature values will be saved to a particle’s custom float data channel.Channel: the custom float data channel in which to store the data.

Enabled: controls whether grid temperature values will be saved to a particle’s custom float data channel.

Channel: the custom float data channel in which to store the data.

sections.heading: Fire (float)
sections.content:
Enabled: controls whether grid fire values will be saved to a particle’s custom float data channel (FumeFX only).Channel: the custom float data channel in which to store the data.

Enabled: controls whether grid fire values will be saved to a particle’s custom float data channel (FumeFX only).

Channel: the custom float data channel in which to store the data.

sections.heading: Inside (float)
sections.content:
Enabled: controls whether a grid inside/outside test will be saved to a particle’s custom float data channel.Channel: the custom float data channel in which to store the data.

Enabled: controls whether a grid inside/outside test will be saved to a particle’s custom float data channel.

Channel: the custom float data channel in which to store the data.

If a particle is inside the fluid grid, a value of ‘1’ will be saved. If a particle is outside the fluid grid, a value of ‘0’ will be saved.
